meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会监听指定 Linear 团队:里面任何工单收到新评论都会自动触发它,无需 @;它在对应评论串里回复,并把每个工单的评论串当作一段独立对话。
howto.when: 当有人在你接管的 Linear 团队里给任意工单发表评论时触发,无需 @ 提及。若使用个人 API 密钥,你自己的评论会被过滤,不会触发它。

say.text: 帮我接入 Linear,让机器人自动回复工单评论。
say.note: 开始执行 add-linear 的安装与接线流程。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 团队接给一个代理,并用 strict 发送策略。
say.note: 只允许注册成员对话;每个工单评论串独立成会话。

say.text: 改用 Personal API Key 接入 Linear。
say.note: 代理会以你的身份发帖,并过滤你自己的评论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude listens to the chosen Linear team: any new comment on an issue automatically triggers it, with no @-mention needed. It replies inside that comment thread and treats each issue thread as its own conversation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a comment is posted on any issue in the wired Linear team; no @-mention is required. With a Personal API key, comments from your own account are filtered and do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Set up Linear so the bot auto-replies to issue comments.
say_en.note: Runs the add-linear installation and wiring flow.

say_en.text: Connect a Linear team to an agent, using the strict sender policy.
Switch to a Personal API Key for Linear instead.
say_en.note: Posts as you; your own comments are filtered.
